author: BBQ78
quote:
1,5 billion dollars. 5,000 people worked on this "game" around 13 years. Literally NOTHING can justify the ton of bugs, rotten code, awful uninteresting missions like "go grab those products to Lusia", and ENDLESS dialogs (aka Tarantino(its not) in this hype product. 

GTA series is targeting ultra realism, and still, npc needs multiple headshots to be killed. You cant pull up gun in some places. You can say "this is game, relax". But hey, at this point, the "game" has become tangled up in itself. Those artificial restrictions are eating the concept of ultra realistic game from the inside.

And off course, 30 fps. I believe 30 fps is playable for games, but not for shooters and racing games(wheres you need to drive a car). But this "game" is both. This is unacceptable. And YES, i believe in such a thing as optimization. PS5 Pro is STRONG console, its definitely can handle it. 

That's not even mentioning a paywall, in a single player game, what a sick joke. 

What can i say overall. This bunch of rotten code an 3d model is gaming industry's CANCER. I’m used to corrupt critics, but if this thing what got 8 nomination BEFORE the release gonna win GOTY... This will be the death of the gaming industry. Period.

Pease️.
